newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Bad management, low exports hit Agrimpex.
newsitem.headline: Bad management, low exports hit Agrimpex.

text.p: Low 1996 wheat exports and poor management at two subsidiaries of grains trading company Agrimpex Rt resulted in an 1996 unconsolidated IAS loss of 57 million forints, a company official said on Monday.

Agrimpex general director Attila Kovacs said that despite a one million tonnes wheat surplus from the 1996 crop, Hungary only exported 250,000 to 270,000 tonnes last year, of which Agrimpex's share was 50,000 tonnes.
In 1995, Hungary exported some 2.5 million tonnes of wheat, of which Agrimpex's share was 411,000 tonnes, he said.
Agrimpex, although mildly in the black according to Hungarian Accounting Standards, would not pay a dividend on its 1996 results but would instead increase its reserves, Kovacs said.
He added that for this year he expected a turnover above 20 billion forints and a pre-tax profit of about 200 million.
On Friday Agrimpex shares closed unchanged at 20,000 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
